matches.assumption: That membership in a type can carry a checked proposition so nothing is verified twice (O2); false if laws end up decorative and values still get re-checked downstream.
That a self-applied, code-as-data kernel buys the flexibility claimed; false if the metacircular core proves unimplementable or never used to operate on Luthier.
That one subtype/constructor/projection pattern covers values, functions and programs alike; false if programs or functions need a different construction.
That stating the law characterizes rather than merely constrains the operation; false if a characterizing law cannot be written and only ad hoc postconditions remain.
matches.change: Adds that the invariant characterizes the operation up to the presentation's equality, so a second implementation is consistency not characterization and the native definition is one more model certified against it.

matches.assumption: That execution can be read as verifying declared equivalences (the declarative/executive map, O4); false if the equivalence proofs cannot be computed by running.
That a few primitives suffice to build the rest in Luthier and reduce by hand (O5); false if the complex edifice forces primitives that cannot be run on paper.
That the disciplines' invariances are what Luthier most needs to express; false if no design decision turns on expressing an invariance.
That a bodyless declaration already is the hole, with 'nothing runs until defined' as its semantics, needing no External type or ? symbol; false if the five roles need distinct constructs.
That a function admits many equivalent paths and Luthier can choose by loss and speed (O4); false if choosing the fastest cannot be done or kept, which Luciano says is not yet started.

That checking a value and sampling a function are one construct differing only in exact vs statistical, with every value carrying its grade; false if the two cannot share one operation or grades do not compose.
